evals.prompt: Create a stakeholder overview document from accepted project knowledge.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-document, uses the customer_spec retrieval policy when durable knowledge is needed, writes under .work-bundle/orchestration/docs/, omits unsupported facts, and does not write durable knowledge.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation specification for the work-bundle migration.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-specification, writes a Markdown spec under .work-bundle/orchestration/spec/active/, updates spec index, and includes execution context.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation plan from an active specification.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-implementation-plan, creates root plan, phase files, task files, and plan index under .work-bundle/orchestration/plan/active/.

evals.prompt: Execute the next task in an existing plan.
evals.expected_output: Selects execute-plan, checks sub-agent support, uses the single-agent fallback when sub-agents are unavailable, executes one task, updates task and phase task status, reports concise execution result, and requires an executor handoff.

evals.prompt: Create an executor-result handoff after implementation.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-handoff, writes executor-result handoffs under .work-bundle/orchestration/handoff/executor/active/, updates handoff index, and does not retrieve or write durable knowledge during execution completion.

evals.prompt: Execute a phase whose next two tasks are independent and have disjoint write scopes, in an environment with sub-agents.
evals.expected_output: Selects execute-plan, uses the sub-agent scheduler path, delegates the independent tasks to multiple sub-agents, waits for completion, validates executor handoffs against task/phase/plan/spec, updates task statuses, and continues scheduling.

evals.prompt: A sub-agent reports completion but its executor handoff omits validation evidence.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the handoff as invalid, does not mark the task complete, records the blocker, and requires a corrected executor handoff before advancing.

evals.prompt: Finish the last task in a phase and then the last phase in a plan.
evals.expected_output: Creates phase-scoped and plan-scoped executor-result handoffs, updates phase and plan statuses to Completed, reports review-plan as the next action, and does not archive artifacts.

evals.prompt: Review an implemented plan where the project files do not satisfy the source specification.
evals.expected_output: Selects review-plan, validates spec/plan/handoffs/project files, creates a new active repair specification with discrepancies and fix instructions, and does not archive artifacts.

evals.prompt: Review an implemented plan where all specification, plan, handoff, and project file checks pass.
evals.expected_output: Selects review-plan, archives the related specification, plan tree, and handoffs, refreshes indexes, and reports review-complete without deleting files.

evals.prompt: Doctor the orchestrator skill for installation health, malformed directives, and workflow bias.
evals.expected_output: Selects doctor, uses dev-rules-doctor first, runs the develop-rules doctor command, audits SKILL.md, directives, README, workflow, evals, helper commands, and cross-skill v3 gateway wiring read-only, checks that execute-plan preserves both sub-agent scheduler and single-agent fallback paths, verifies archival belongs to review-plan, and reports concrete repairs without changing files.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation plan from v3 retrieved context containing authority, candidate, background, and blocked notes.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-implementation-plan, maps the workflow to the implementation_plan retrieval policy, carries authority context into executable tasks, labels candidate/background/blocked context separately, and does not create tasks from non-authority notes.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation specification from v3 project knowledge where customer-design notes match the query.
evals.expected_output: Selects create-specification, maps the workflow to the implementation_spec policy, treats development-design and implementation notes as authority, labels customer-design notes as supporting background or constraints, and cites source paths without treating background as implementation authority.

evals.prompt: Review a completed plan that should promote a confirmed note to implemented.
evals.expected_output: Selects review-plan, requires validation evidence suitable for front matter evidence before recommending implemented status, and does not silently write durable knowledge.

v4_evals.description: Validate v4 compact runtime and boundary behavior.
